scope: source and sensor-readiness diagnosis only; not localization or calibration
pairing_semantics: offline nearest header, one-to-one, same host; never a causal fusion admission rule or independent synchronization bound
quiet_candidate_semantics: first 5s recorder interval if no recorded nonzero command; not proof of physical rest or accepted bias/noise calibration
quaternion_handling: normalize only temporary diagnostic copy; preserve original norm and bytes
holdout_policy: T09 T11 T13 T15 not decoded or evaluated
